fields.title: Tenpo Sonshō Shūzen Yōsei ni kansuru Shokan

receiver.name: Controleur J. H. van den Bosch

letter.message: Kōkyō kōji no ryūshutsu ni yoru waga tenpo no kiso sonshō to shōgyō katsudō no shōgai ni kan shi, futatabi kōkyū teki na shūzen to baishō o yōsei itashimasu. Sōki no ketsudan o o-negai mōshiagemasu.

context.purpose: Kiso shinshoku no shūzen oyobi shōgyō sonshitsu no baishō no sokushin.

claims.fact: Kojin shokan wa, shinseisha ga kōzōteki shūzen to baishō o chokusetsu yōkyū shite iru koto o shōmei suru.
